messages:
Priya • AE: Hi team — passing Astraa Labs over to CS. Signed contract includes Dedicated + Private. High priority on SSO + VPC. Renewal cadence: annual on 2025-06-10.
Jordan • CSM: Thanks Priya. Quick snapshot: trial completed, 3 pilot teams, they run high-throughput batch embeddings. Expecting ~5x token volume month 1 if production.
Priya • AE: Noted. They asked about quota burst and backup region failover. Also legal requested HSM integration and SOC2 attestation.
Jordan • CSM: Owners: Jordan = primary CSM; Sam = first-line support contact; Marta = eng escalation for infra/Private deploy. I'll schedule intro call.
Sam • Support: I'll create a triage ticket and link the infra runbook. Ticket: #CS-4582 — SSO errors during SAML metadata import. Attach logs: `Invalid ACS URL` on import.
Marta • Eng: I'll spin up a private evaluation deployment in staging (region: us-west2). ETA 48h. Need the customer's VPC CIDR and KMS ARN.
Jordan • CSM: Action items: 1) Intro call w/ customer + tech leads — Jordan to book (target Fri 10am PT). 2) Sam opens CS-4582 (in progress). 3) Marta to provision staging and confirm KMS integration. 4) Jordan to coordinate enablement training for engineering team — 2 x 90m sessions. 5) Priya to deliver billing appendix and renewal terms.
Priya • AE: Confirmed, I sent the billing appendix to legal and CC'd Jordan.
onboard-bot: Reminder — onboarding checklist item 'SSO configured' pending. Due in 3 days.
Jordan • CSM: Risk notes: Renewal flagged: medium-high — need to hit performance SLAs in first 30 days. Key metric: 99th pct latency < 750ms for embed/stream endpoints. If we miss, they may request early contract renegotiation.
Sam • Support: For the SSO error, ask them to share the full SAML metadata and the ACS URL they provided. Also check if the IDP uses signed assertions.
Marta • Eng: For Private deploy, recommend quantized model variant by default to contain GPU footprint; I'll propose autoscale floor and burst policy. Sharing recommended instance sizing: 4x A10G with 8 vCPU control plane.
Jordan • CSM: I'll capture these recommendations in the customer runbook and tag owners. Anyone who will own the post-launch QA check?
Marta • Eng: I'll own post-launch performance QA (first 7 days). Sam will handle support ticketing. Jordan will cover enablement and CS success metrics.
Priya • AE: Customer success criteria: reduced inference latency, stable SSO, and clear cost forecast. They want a monthly cost projection by launch day.
Jordan • CSM: Next steps timeline: - Today: Sam opens ticket + ask for SAML metadata. - Tomorrow: Priya confirm billing appendix; Marta starts staging. - Fri: Intro call + enablement scheduling. - Launch target: 2024-05-15.
Sam • Support: Ack. I'll include runbook snippet for rollback and escalation path: `if private node OOM -> scale up then rollback to hosted model-variant`.
Jordan • CSM: Feedback capture: we'll run a 2-week post-launch survey + NPS check at 30 days. Assigning survey owner: Jordan.
Priya • AE: anything else?
Marta • Eng: Need customer contact info for VPC: infra@astraalabs.com and sec-contact@astraalabs.com. Priya can confirm.
Priya • AE: Confirmed. I also added legal contact.
Jordan • CSM: Great — closing the handoff. I'll post a short summary after the intro call and update the runbook. :rocket:
